# Synthetic Fortinet FortiGate Configuration Export
! For automated testing of firewall-acl-auditor
# Device: SYNTHETIC-MOCK-FORTIGATE-01
config firewall policy
    edit 10
        set name "SYNTHETIC-PERMIT-SUBNET1"
        set srcintf "port1"
        set dstintf "port2"
        set srcaddr "192.0.2.0/24"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
    next
    edit 20
        set name "SYNTHETIC-PERMIT-WEB"
        set srcintf "port1"
        set dstintf "port2"
        set srcaddr "192.0.2.0/24"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "HTTPS"
    next
    edit 30
        set name "SYNTHETIC-BLOCK-SUBRANGE"
        set srcintf "port1"
        set dstintf "port2"
        set srcaddr "192.0.2.64/26"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action deny
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
    next
    edit 40
        set name "SYNTHETIC-PERMIT-TELNET"
        set srcintf "port1"
        set dstintf "port2"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "198.51.100.50/32"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "TELNET"
    next
    edit 50
        set name "SYNTHETIC-ANY-ANY"
        set srcintf "port1"
        set dstintf "port2"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
    next
    edit 60
        set name "SYNTHETIC-DISABLED-RULE"
        set srcintf "port1"
        set dstintf "port2"
        set srcaddr "203.0.113.0/24"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action deny
        set status disable
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
    next
end
